g.text: OpenVela memory model: the build changes the boundary
OV2 · NuttX configuration options, not a claim that every OpenVela board supports all three
A separate stack is NOT memory isolation. Protected build separates user from kernel; kernel build adds MMU address environments.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
